title: Group and summarise
summary: groupby gathers rows with the same key. An aggregation, such as mean, gives one summary for each group.
introduction: groupby gathers rows with the same key. An aggregation, such as mean, gives one summary for each group. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: groupby gathers rows with the same key. An aggregation, such as mean, gives one summary for each group.

blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Asha", "Ben", "Cara"],
    "score": [8, 6, 9],
    "team": ["red", "blue", "red"]
})

means = df.groupby("team")["score"].mean()
print(float(means.loc["red"]))
blocks.title: Group and summarise

blocks.text: The result is 8.5. The red team has scores 8 and 9, whose average is 8.5.

blocks.text: A small group's average can be unstable; keep its size in mind.
